⊙.justification: identity of the partial product carried forward

∋.justification: multiplication rejoining forked arms into one lift state

⊞.justification: a paradice holding both admissible pairs live before pruning

phase_3.void_description: No column opened and no carry stored
phase_3.true_description: A bit pair admitted by the column parity relation with gamma emitted
phase_3.false_description: A bit pair rejected by the column parity relation
phase_3.both_description: Two admissible bit pairs held live at one column before the parity check selects

steps.domain_action: odd N enters with p0 q0 forced to one
open column zero with initial carry zero
fork the lift state over candidate bit pairs
admit pairs where c plus mid plus a plus b matches n_k
reject pairs where parity mismatches n_k
rejoin admitted arms into the surviving lift set
chain the fused state into the next column
read gamma_k as c_k mod 2 from the carried value
carry the partial product identity forward
hold the paired survivors as one branching state
advance across all columns to width B
drain check remaining columns against top bits of N
record p q and gamma on closure
verify p times q equals N and P Q equals N plus Gamma in F2

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The column relation translating N bits into parity constraints
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Carry values passed forward one column at a time
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Stack of partial states holding p_k q_k and carry
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: LSB first order fixed by the convolution index
phase_5.alfs_store: missing_morphism.py hensel_morphism plus verify as the reference lift

phase_6.cycle_cost: One column constraint check per lifted bit plus one stack node per survivor
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: An unfactored odd N with a width bound and a node budget
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A recorded pair with gamma plus a spent node count
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the emitted gamma and the drain check preserve the column relation exactly
